as_told.title: Wernher von Braun warned Carol Rosin of a planned alien invasion

plain: The rocket scientist Wernher von Braun is said to have warned, near the end of his life, that powerful people would one day stage a fake alien threat to unite the world. The UFO activist Steven Greer says he has this from his friend Carol Rosin, who heard it from von Braun on his deathbed. Greer calls it "the card they want to play" and a "false flag." In one telling he puts von Braun's death in 1974, while the story dates the warning to 1977. Michels mentions it too, speaking of von Braun at the end of his life talking to a woman whose name he garbles as "Carolyn Ross." If true, it would mean that a coming alien scare should be treated as a deception.
